factory_info.layout_description: A parallel production line laid out along the sequence Palletizing -> Assembly -> Cutting -> Machining -> Surface Treatment -> Quality Inspection, with stations grouped by workflow step.

parallel_groups.reasoning: Steps Assembly, Quality Inspection do not share equipment or line dependencies, so they can run concurrently without blocking one another.
